envelope.description: Give the shared fake DOM a textOf helper that reads descendants' text

body.title: Give the shared fake DOM a textOf helper that reads descendants' text
body.summary: Add an exported textOf(node) helper to fake-dom.ts that joins the text of a node's descendants as the real textContent does, and wire createTextNode into the chat-shell document stub. The fake's own textContent getter is NOT changed: making it join children changed 11 docs-review-panel tests, which collect textContent over every element and rely on it being a node's own text. Tests that read a highlighted diff line's text read it through textOf. This replaces the LLD's wording that the getter joins children.
acceptanceChecks: textOf joins the text of a node's text-node and element descendants, and returns a childless node's own text
an element's textContent is still its own text, and setting textContent still clears the children as fake-dom.test.ts asserts
every suite that uses fake-dom.ts passes unchanged

tests.name: the shared fake DOM's textOf joins descendants' text while textContent stays its own text and still clears children when set
